title: MediaOCD to Release Restored HD Vampire Princess Miyu Anime on BD on its Website Only on September 8
content: AnimEigo and MediaOCD announced on Thursday they will release the restored HD Blu-ray Disc of the 1988-1989 four-episode OVA adaptation of Narumi Kakinouchi 's Vampire Princess Miyu manga "on or before" September 8, only on MediaOCD 's website.
author: ANN

title: 5 Magic-Fueled 2026 Anime Series You Need to See If You Love KPop Demon Hunters
content: Even nearly a year since its release, KPop Demon Hunters continues to remain popular, with fans eagerly awaiting the sequel to the Netflix sensation. While there have been promising updates regarding how the franchise will continue, it is clear that the new releases are far from arriving anytime soon.
author: ComicBook

title: Paradox Live The Animation Gets Film Project by Studio GRAPH77
content: The " Paradox Live Dope Show 2026" event announced this weekend that the Paradox Live The Animation series will have an upcoming film project. According to the teaser above, Studio GRAPH77 ( Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 's "Shikaku") is producing the film project.

title: Amu Meguro's Midori Loves My Sister Manga Gets Live-Action Film on December 4
content: A website opened on Sunday to announce a live-action film adaptation of Amu Meguro 's Midori Loves My Sister ( Onē-chan no Midori-kun or literally My Sister's Midori-kun) manga, which will open in Japan on December 4.

title: Chainsmoker Cat TV Anime Reveals Main Trailer, Theme Song Artists, More Staff Members
content: The staff for the television anime of Nyan Nyan Factory 's Chainsmoker Cat ( Yanineko ) manga revealed the anime's main promotional video, theme songs, and additional staff members on Sunday. The promo video previews the opening theme song "Nanmonee" by rock band Wasureranneyo .
author: ANN

title: Wasted Chef Anime Film Reveals Teaser Trailer, Manga Adaptation
content: The official website for director Takayuki Hirao 's ( Magical Sisters Yoyo & Nene ) Wasted Chef anime film project opened on Sunday and revealed its teaser trailer, and manga adaptation, which will launch in Kadokawa 's Young Ace magazine on June 4. Aero05 will draw the manga adaptation.
author: ANN

title: WASTED CHEF Original Anime Film by Pompo the Cinephile Director Takayuki Hirao Announced
content: KADOKAWA has announced a new original anime film from Pompo the Cinephile director Takayuki Hirao, referred to by the project code WASTED CHEF . The film revealed its first teaser trailer, visual, and main staff members on May 31.
author: Anime Corner
